limitations: Maize pilot only; no category approval or GPU timing.
Color shadows retain DoubleSide; shadowFront/depth/ground masks are separate gates.
Actual source growth/bridge shaders and web textures; indexed source isolates indexing from culling.
Candidate resource gates remain unchanged; rendered quality cannot waive triangle budget.
Geometry-preserving partial-sidedness design; true thin leaves remain DoubleSide, no approval of geometric leaf repair.
Diagnostic DOUBLE_SIDED define preserves original normal/TBN shader paths while core material.side still enables culling; no original failure is reinterpreted and no performance attribution.
